headline: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
summary: Canva introduces "Canva Craft," a new AI image generation model. It competes with OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google's AI models. Craft uses a two-stage process for precision, planning designs before generation.

headline: PC shipments dropped over 20 percent in Q3 due to RAM price hikes
summary: Global PC shipments plunged 21% year-over-year in Q3 2026. The decline is linked to rising RAM prices impacting demand. Smartphone shipments also hit a 14-year low in the same quarter.

headline: Fall 2026 earnings watch
summary: Tech companies' Fall 2026 earnings reports are under scrutiny. Focus is on AI integration, compute assets, and new tech like flying cars. Analysts will assess wins, losses, and future directions for the sector.

headline: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
summary: Meta updated its terms, removing direct language about scraping news sites for AI. Legal experts argue the changes are insufficient to prevent scraping. Concerns remain over Meta's ability to train AI on news content via "associated with your products or services" clause.

headline: Amazon Has a Sale on Magic: The Gathering Booster Boxes Even Before Black Friday Kicks Off
summary: Amazon offers early Black Friday discounts on Magic: The Gathering. Deals include Play Booster Boxes for popular sets like Marvel and The Hobbit. Unreleased Star Trek sets are also available at reduced prices.

headline: Young Sheldon Star Annie Potts Was 'Sad' About Jim Parsons' 'Mean' Sheldon Cameo
summary: Annie Potts, who played Meemaw in Young Sheldon, expressed disappointment. She was "a little sad" about Jim Parsons' adult Sheldon cameo in the finale. Potts felt adult Sheldon remained "mean and unchanged," unlike how she envisioned.

headline: Tom Skerritt Dies: Alien and Top Gun Actor Was 93
summary: Veteran actor Tom Skerritt has passed away at 93. He was known for iconic roles in films like "Alien" and "Top Gun." Skerritt died of natural causes on Wednesday.

headline: Alienware 32" 4K 240Hz OLED Gaming Monitor Hits All-Time Low Price
summary: Alienware's 32-inch 4K 240Hz Quantum-Dot OLED gaming monitor is on sale. The high-performance display has reached an unprecedented low price. Considered a top choice for serious 4K gaming enthusiasts.

headline: UK Warned to Prepare for Supply Chain Disruptions from Cyber or Climate Threats
summary: The UK defence secretary warns the public to prepare for supply chain disruptions. Threats include cyberattacks and climate emergencies. The nation must be ready for impacts on essential goods and services.

headline: Critical Cyber-Security Flaw in PHP Triggers Race to Update Systems
summary: A critical cybersecurity vulnerability was discovered in PHP. The flaw led to websites being taken offline for urgent updates. Organizations are scrambling to patch their computer systems and services.

headline: Trump Claims Musk Restored Ukraine's Starlink Access
summary: Donald Trump stated Elon Musk has restored Ukraine's Starlink network access. Ukraine relies heavily on Starlink for military communications. Musk has previously denied restricting Starlink access in Ukraine.

headline: Raye Wins Mercury Prize with 'This Music May Contain Hope'
summary: Pop star Raye has been awarded the prestigious Mercury Prize. She won for her album "This Music May Contain Hope." Raye beat nominees like Paul McCartney and Suede, securing the £25,000 prize.
